source.cfbd: optional_when_CFBD_API_KEY (ratings/sp + advanced); not used for this package
source.pbp: warehouse team_season_efficiency overlay for official-FBS fills (seasons ≤ 2025, n_games ≥ 8)

normalization.score_map: off_eff/def_eff = 50 + 18*z (clamp 5–95); defense z inverted so higher=better
normalization.success_explosiveness: Proxies from SP+ z-scores (muted), not true success-rate / iso-explosiveness PBP

notes: 2025 final SP+ is opponent-adjusted efficiency (Bill Connelly). Packaged for 2026 preseason carry.
No full PBP store in-repo; CFBD advanced/PPA optional when key present.
success_off/def and explosiveness are approximate SP+-correlated proxies.
Early 2026 season: blend prior-year efficiency with roster/QB identity; labeled approximate.
Do not treat as live in-season SP+ updates until a refresh pipeline is wired.
2026-08-14: warehouse PBP EPA overlay replaced official-FBS league_average_fill rows. FCS extras dropped. tanh calibration unchanged.
